messages:
Maya (Product): Heads-up — PRD draft for Chat + Embeddings + Rerank endpoints is posted. Need design/eng/QA feedback on acceptance criteria and edge cases by Fri EOD. Link: https://confluence/redwood/prd/chat-embed-rerank (draft)

Alex (Eng): Skimming now. Two quick questions: 1) Is 'rerank' a separate endpoint or an option on completions? 2) embeddings batching SLO?

Maya (Product): Plan is separate rerank endpoint to avoid coupling with generation. Embeddings should support async batch up to 1000 vectors — see ACs.

Sam (Eng-ML): For embeddings, define deterministic vector order and stable id mapping on retries. Also quantization nuance: we need float32 outputs for first launch.

Rachel (DevEx): SDK changes: add rerank() method, embeddings.batch() with progress callback. Need sample snippet for migration.

Lee (Design): UX — CLI and Console examples. For rerank we need to show 'score explanation' toggle. Also small mock:
```
client.rerank(model='rw-rerank-1', query='q', candidates=[...])
```

Jordan (QA): Acceptance tests proposal:
- AC1: Chat p95 latency <150ms for short conv (<128 tokens) on hosted small instance
- AC2: Embeddings stable across identical inputs (bitwise or float tolerance?)
- AC3: Rerank returns consistent ordering for ties, documented tie-breaker

Alex (Eng): On AC2, we should state numeric tolerance: cosine similarity diff <1e-6 on same platform. For cross-quantized variants, call out expected variation.

Maya (Product): Launch criteria: docs + SDK + 2 partner integrations + CI regression tests + runbook for fallbacks. If any of these missing, hold GA.

Sam (Eng-ML): Edge cases: very long candidate lists for rerank (>10k) should return 413 or paginated response. Also need streaming for chat partials.

Rachel (DevEx): I'll draft SDK PR and example notebook. Can we get a sample dataset for rerank tests (legal redactions needed)? @Security?

Lee (Design): Will attach Console mock in thread. One more: rename param 'score' to 'rank_score' to avoid collision.

Maya (Product): Thanks — I'll update PRD with these ACs and add a clear migration guide. Please add comments on the Confluence doc by Thu EOD. @alex @sam @jordan

deploy-bot: Deploy of prd/docs branch succeeded (ci-docs #249) :white_check_mark:

Alex (Eng): Small follow-up: fallback policy if model unavailable — route to lighter model with warning header. Need to codify.

Jordan (QA): I'll add end-to-end tests for fallback and for embeddings order stability.

Maya (Product): Great. I'll schedule a short spec sync Friday 10am to lock scope. Agenda: AC signoff, launch gating, rollout strategy.
